anchor.saved_tensor: both subtokens separately at embedding output and transformer outputs 1--80
anchor.site: both exact symbol subtokens in each Background label line
anchor.subtoken_pooling_for_probes: arithmetic mean of the two subtokens

controls: cross patch at embedding output only
cross patch at all causally effective hidden-state layers 0--79
causal_patching.primary_endpoint: episode-level mean of the regime-aligned correct-into-swapped shift and the sign-reversed swapped-into-correct shift
causal_patching.primary_layer_rule: three contiguous hidden-state layers centered on the development-selected primary relational-probe layer; clamp to 1--3 or 77--79 at boundaries
causal_patching.site: both City C symbol subtokens only

paper_integration: prospective checkpoint replication; integrate only after frozen analysis

probe.cv: four episode-disjoint, fully factorially balanced folds
probe.final_output_layer: layer 80 is saved as a diagnostic but is ineligible for selection because it has no downstream transformer block
probe.layer_selection: maximum development CV among causally effective transformer outputs 1--79; earlier layer breaks ties

permutation.scheme: held-out labels permuted with the development-selected representation, layer, ridge, and fitted probe fixed

replication.confirmatory_claim: the development-selected three-layer City C label patch has a positive bidirectional regime-aligned effect at k=0
replication.target_selection_rule: the largest completed Qwen checkpoint with significant arbitrary-label forecast discrimination and held-out decoding; fixed before any label-token activation or patch result

definitions.city_c_minus_matching_reference: City C minus matching A/B label state
definitions.city_c_minus_nonmatching_reference: City C minus other A/B label state
definitions.matching_minus_nonmatching_reference: matching A/B minus other A/B label state
definitions.matching_reference: A/B label state whose symbol matches City C

checks: at least 77 complete causal-patch episodes at k=0
positive mean in both patch directions
stability_gate_before_cross_family_repli.failure_action: stop; report the checkpoint replication as failed
stability_gate_before_cross_family_repli.pass_action: report the prospectively frozen checkpoint replication

task_design.label_extraction_scope: k=0 correct and swapped arms only; k=4 is causally identical through the City C label and is not duplicated
